numeric_rule.selected_events: Exactly the 126 source-adjudicated AMD/NVDA quarter slots, no additional source request or market outcome selection.
numeric_rule.precedence: If explicit next-quarter revenue amount/range/midpoint in USD is present, use its midpoint or central amount and divide by same original release reported current-quarter GAAP consolidated revenue in USD; subtract1. If no amount, use an explicitly numeric sequential revenue-growth percentage midpoint; if qualitative/ambiguous, unknown.
numeric_rule.units: Unify USD million/billion before division; percent values divide by100. For amount plus/minus uncertainty, central amount is midpoint. Preserve reported interval/uncertainty separately; no ex-post realized next-quarter revenue.
numeric_rule.source_text: Only SEC original 8-K/EX-99.1/EX-95.1 issuer earnings release text at the selected accession; do not use later CFO commentary, external consensus or revised filings.
numeric_rule.AMD_2011_qualitative: Unknown, do not encode flat as zero.
numeric_rule.NVDA_2014_late_guidance: Numeric event begins at May8 original filing, not May6 earnings.

prospective_feature.name: AMD_NVDA_forward_growth_positive_breadth
prospective_feature.formula: Among two concurrently known most recent issuer forward sequential-revenue-growth numbers, (1[AMD>0]+1[NVDA>0])/2; if either issuer source unknown or stale after four calendar months, feature unknown.

stop: Hash/issuer/quarter mismatch stops. Unsupported numeric wording remains unknown with exact original excerpt; no manual favorable filling or outcome-guided parser repair. Source numeric completeness and PIT must pass before Qlib mapping or one fixed information screen.
